pitches: bases loaded, two out, down a run, and wrobleski opens with a slider at the knees for a called strike. the model was sitting fastball.
a slower sweeper this time, 82 and change, low over the plate. hoskins gets a piece of it and it's 0-2.
now the heat, 96.6, but it's up out of the zone. with two strikes he can afford to miss, and he does. 1-2.
another fastball up and out of the zone. two straight heaters missing high and it's 2-2.
back to the sweeper, but it's well off the plate away and hoskins lays off. full count with the bases loaded.
full count, he goes slider and it's off the plate inside. ball four, and that forces in a run.
823972-51.wrap: wrobleski got to 0-2 with two sharp breaking balls, then missed with four straight. the bases-loaded walk scores austin hedges and cleveland leads 2-0.

pitches: klein starts with 96 at the letters and martínez just ticks it back. the model called fastball and got it.
the curveball after the high heat changes his eye level, but it misses away. 1-1.
a second straight curveball, this one up and out of the zone. martínez isn't chasing. 2-1.
a sweeper, which the model gave all of 3 percent. it misses up, and klein is behind 3-1.
gutsy. a 3-1 sweeper, and it drops in at the knees for a called strike. full count.
sweeper again at 3-2. this one's up in the zone and martínez fouls it back.
a fourth straight sweeper, still around the plate, still being fouled off. klein trusts it with the count full.
finally the fastball, 98.2, the hardest pitch of the at-bat, but it misses inside. ball four.
823970-52.wrap: klein fell behind with three straight breaking balls out of the zone, battled back to full, then missed with 98 on the eighth pitch. martínez walks and two are aboard.

pitches: yamamoto opens with the splitter away, his second pitch by usage, and lukes takes it for ball one.
lukes chases a 95.6 mph fastball off the plate inside. the model leaned splitter there, giving the heater 31 percent.
splitter in the dirt, blocked. the model called this one. 2-1.
another splitter at 92 and lukes spoils it. that's three splitters in four pitches. 2-2.
a cutter, the first of the at-bat, and the model gave it just 10 percent. lukes stays alive with a foul.
up comes the fastball, 94.9, and lukes fouls that off too. he has an answer for everything so far.
the splitter misses away and we go full. the model called the pitch, at 42 percent.
full count, and yamamoto goes cutter at the top of the zone. lukes takes it, and it's called strike three.
822831-14.wrap: yamamoto showed lukes six splitters and fastballs, then froze him with a 3-2 cutter he'd thrown only once. inning over, runner stranded at second.

pitches: klein opens with a sweeper up in the zone and jung fouls it. the model was looking fastball.
now 97.2 at belt height and jung takes it. 0-2.
back to the sweeper with two strikes, and jung gets just enough to stay alive.
fastball up, fouled back. jung is hanging in against both pitches.
a third pitch type, the curveball, but it misses away. 1-2.
another curveball out of the zone. jung isn't biting, and it's 2-2.
97.7, but it misses up, and a count that was 0-2 is now full. the model had fastball at 63 percent.
a full-count sweeper that sails up out of the zone, and jung protects with a foul.
another sweeper, this one off the plate away, and jung swings through it. strike three.
823966-79.wrap: klein had jung 0-2, lost him to full with three straight misses, then won it with back-to-back sweepers out of the zone. jung went down chasing.

pitches: treinen, on his first pitch of the outing in a tie game, starts with the sweeper. it's called a strike, though it tracks just off the plate away.
now the sinker at 96.6, running the other way, but it misses inside. 1-1.
robert chases a sweeper off the plate away. the model had slider at 54 percent there. 1-2.
the model is even surer now, 68 percent, and it's right, but robert takes this sweeper. 2-2.
a sweeper over the plate this time and robert fouls it off.
a fifth sweeper of the at-bat and it misses. full count, two out, runners at the corners.
and another sweeper, low and on the edge. robert takes, and it's called strike three.
823965-54.wrap: six sweepers in seven pitches. robert challenged the last one, the call stood, and treinen strands two runners in a tie game.

pitches: ohtani opens with a 76.7 mph curveball, a pitch he's thrown only 6 percent of the time. lindor fouls it.
then the splitter, and lindor chases. two pitches, both ones he rarely throws, and it's 0-2.
another splitter, this one in the dirt and blocked. 1-2.
now the fastball, 99.3, but it misses. lindor has seen three very different speeds already.
98 right down the middle, and lindor can only foul it back.
splitter, and lindor stays alive again.
fastball up, fouled off. three straight pitches at 2-2, three straight fouls.
the curveball again, but it misses inside. full count.
a 3-2 splitter, which the model gave just 5 percent. lindor fouls it.
his most-used pitch, the slider, shows up for the first time on pitch ten. fouled away.
99.6, the hardest pitch of the at-bat, and lindor can only tip it into the mitt. strike three.
823963-19.wrap: eleven pitches, four pitch types, and lindor fouled off six of them before ohtani finished it with 99.6 that he could only tip into the glove.

pitches: treinen starts with a four-seamer, a pitch he's used 11 percent of the time, and steals strike one. the model had it at 12 percent.
a cutter that misses away. 1-1.
the same cutter, up this time, and caissie fouls it off. 1-2.
a four-seamer up, another foul. the model keeps waiting on the slider.
there it is, the sweeper, the pitch he throws most. caissie lays off. 2-2.
back to the cutter up, fouled away.
a sinker, the fourth different pitch of the at-bat. it misses up and we're full.
a full-count four-seamer, which the model gave 9 percent. caissie fouls it.
and the sweeper, off the plate inside. caissie chases, strike three.
823956-60.wrap: treinen mixed four pitches, leaning on his least-used ones to set it up, then got caissie to chase the sweeper. connor norby stole third on the play.

pitches: sheehan opens with a changeup for a called strike. it's his third pitch by usage, and the model didn't see it coming.
a second changeup, and gorman takes it again. 0-2, two pitches, no swings.
now the fastball, 95.2, but it's up. with two strikes there's room to waste one.
another fastball up out of the zone. 2-2, and gorman still hasn't swung.
slider in the dirt, blocked. three straight misses and the count is full.
another slider, and this one is up in the zone. gorman fouls it, his first swing.
full-count fastball, 92.9, up out of the zone, and gorman puts it in play.
823066-8.wrap: sheehan got ahead 0-2 with changeups, then couldn't put gorman away. the 3-2 fastball was up out of the zone and gorman hit it out to right anyway.

pitches: kyle hurt is basically two pitches, fastball and changeup, and he starts with 96.1 at the knees. fouled back.
another fastball, a bit up. 1-1.
the changeup, and the model called it. yastrzemski fouls it off.
97.5, up out of the zone. 2-2.
a fastball down the middle and yastrzemski just gets a piece.
changeup at the knees, fouled. the model has called changeup on every pitch so far.
fastball misses inside, full count, two out, runners at the corners.
96.8, fouled off. yastrzemski keeps matching the heater.
the model finally flips to fastball, and so does hurt, up out of the zone. yastrzemski swings through it, strike three.
823957-46.wrap: hurt threw yastrzemski seven fastballs and two changeups and won with the heat. a 3-2 fastball up out of the zone got the swing and miss, stranding two.

pitches: brock stewart starts riley with a fastball that misses up. ball one.
a sweeper over the plate, and riley fouls it off. 1-1.
the fastball misses up again. 2-1.
a sinker now, his fourth pitch by usage, inside, and riley fouls it. 2-2.
sweeper off the plate away, riley takes. full count with two on.
3-2 and stewart goes fastball at the top of the zone. riley swings through it. strike three.
823957-61.wrap: stewart fell behind twice but never gave in. with the count full he challenged riley with 95.9 at the top of the zone and got the swing and miss.

pitches: bases loaded, tie game, and vesia steals strike one with a slider. the model had it at 52 percent.
the fastball misses up. 1-1.
slider off the plate away, and devers doesn't bite. 2-1.
another fastball misses away. 3-1 with the bases loaded.
the model was 79 percent sure of a 3-1 fastball, and it was right. devers swings through it. full count.
another fastball up out of the zone, fouled away.
and the fastball misses up. ball four, and a run is forced in.
823953-59.wrap: vesia was ahead early but missed with four of his last six. the bases-loaded walk scores jung hoo lee and san francisco takes a 4-3 lead.

pitches: ohtani opens with an 80 mph sweeper up in the zone, and andujar takes it for strike one.
a firmer sweeper at 85.2, off the plate away. 1-1. same pitch, five mph apart.
now 96.6 at the knees and andujar tips it. 1-2. the model was still on the slider.
sweeper away, fouled off.
98.2, but it misses away. 2-2.
another fastball off the plate away, and a 1-2 count has gone full.
full-count sweeper, fouled.
98 and fouled again. andujar is not going away.
98.8, the hardest yet, still fouled off.
another fastball up, another foul. ten pitches deep.
and the sweeper off the plate away. andujar finally chases and misses. strike three.
823299-7.wrap: andujar fouled off four straight at 3-2, including three fastballs near 98. ohtani dropped to 87 on the sweeper and got the chase.

pitches: down four in the first with the bases loaded, wrobleski starts chourio with a 72.8 mph curveball. fouled.
then 93.5 up out of the zone and chourio chases. a 20 mph gap between pitches. 0-2.
fastball up and out of the zone, fouled.
another one up, fouled again.
a 69.7 mph curveball, his slowest yet, and it misses away. 1-2.
fastball low, out of the zone. 2-2.
the slider, his third pitch, low, and chourio fouls it.
fastball up, fouled. eight pitches.
fastball misses up and it's full. bases loaded, two out.
fastball up out of the zone, chourio chases. strike three, and the bases stay loaded.
823788-14.wrap: wrobleski used two curveballs under 73 mph to make the fastball look faster, and chourio chased two fastballs out of the zone, including the last. three runners stranded.

pitches: sasaki starts with a splitter at 994 rpm, barely spinning, but it's up and bauers takes it.
a second splitter misses low. 2-0.
the fastball, on the upper edge away, and it's called a ball. 3-0.

another fastball and bauers swings through it. full count after starting 3-0.
97.1, fouled. sasaki is all fastball now.
a slider, the first of the at-bat. the model gave it 8 percent. fouled.
fastball, low, fouled again.
another slider, low, and bauers swings through it. strike three.
823787-10.wrap: sasaki fell behind 3-0, then never threw another ball. four fastballs and two sliders, and the last slider, which the model gave 13 percent, got the swing and miss.

pitches: edgardo henriquez's first pitch of the day is a 99.6 mph sinker at the knees. strike one, and the model called it.

a four-seamer at 101.4 right down the middle, and neto fouls it. the model had slider.
slider misses inside. 2-2.
101.7 inside, fouled away.
slider low, out of the zone. full count.
101.8, the hardest pitch yet, on the corner at the knees. neto swings through it. strike three.
823941-14.wrap: henriquez threw five pitches at 99.6 or harder and finished neto with 101.8. the sliders missed, but the sinker didn't need help.

pitches: hurt opens with the changeup at the knees for strike one.

fastball in the dirt, blocked. 3-1.

98.1 up, fouled.
98.4 at the top of the zone, and caminero tips it into the mitt. strike three.
823938-55.wrap: behind 3-1 in a tie game, hurt got a foul on the changeup, then went to two fastballs at 98-plus up in the zone. caminero tipped the last one into the glove.

pitches: one-run lead, bases loaded, two out in the ninth. vesia starts with a slider that misses up.
fastball up out of the zone and mullins chases. 1-1.
another fastball up, and mullins takes. 2-1.
a slider in the zone and mullins swings through it. 2-2.
fastball misses up. full count, bases loaded, ninth inning, one-run game.
full-count slider, low, and mullins swings through it. strike three, game over.
823940-79.wrap: vesia went to the slider with everything on the line and mullins swung through it. three runners stranded and the dodgers hold on, 5-4.

98.9, off the plate away. 1-1.
slider misses inside. 2-1.

a 3-1 slider, while the model said fastball, and it's right down the middle for a called strike. full count.
slider below the zone and bogaerts chases. strike three.
823281-68.wrap: scott threw five sliders in six pitches, all around 90, and after falling to 3-1 he got a called strike and a chase. one out, two still aboard.

pitches: a one-run lead in the ninth, and scott's first pitch is a slider that misses low.
another slider, another miss, this one inside. 2-0.
a third straight slider, and this one catches the corner. 2-1. the model keeps calling fastball.
slider number four misses away. 3-1 to the leadoff man.
five sliders in a row, and the 3-1 one goes right down the middle for a strike. full count.
finally the fastball, 97.9, just as the model switched to slider. taylor fouls it.
back to the slider, fouled.
same pitch, same spot, same result.
slider below the zone and taylor swings through it. strike three.
823933-69.wrap: eight sliders in nine pitches to the leadoff man in a one-run ninth. the model called fastball on all eight of them, and taylor went down swinging at the last.

pitches: down a run in the ninth, phillips starts with a cutter up and moniak chases. the model called it.
sweeper at the knees, called a ball. 1-1.
96.8 up, fouled.
98.2, fouled again. still 1-2.
sweeper below the zone, the model's call at 53 percent. moniak takes. 2-2.
a sinker at 98.4, the fourth pitch type of the at-bat, which the model gave 7 percent. fouled.
a cutter at 95 misses up. full count.
full-count sweeper on the edge, and moniak takes it. strike three.
823929-70.wrap: phillips used all four of his pitches and, with the count full, went to the sweeper, the one he throws most. moniak took it for strike three.

pitches: runners at second and third, and sasaki challenges julien with 99.1 down the middle. fouled.
same pitch, same spot, same speed. 0-2.
a splitter at 800 rpm, which is almost no spin at all. julien takes it. 1-2.
99.3, but low, out of the zone. 2-2.
splitter in the dirt, blocked, with a runner on third. full count.
another splitter, low, and julien fouls it.
100.1 down the middle, and julien fouls it back.
a slider, the first of the at-bat, and julien takes it at the knees. strike three. the model gave it 10 percent.
823928-30.wrap: sasaki threw julien fastballs and splitters for seven pitches, then a slider he hadn't seen. julien froze for the second out.

pitches: klein starts benge with a sweeper right down the middle, and benge takes it. the model gave the slider 11 percent.
curveball misses inside. 1-1.
98, low and out of the zone. 2-1.
sweeper off the plate inside. 3-1, runners at the corners.
3-1 fastball, the model's call at 65 percent, and benge takes it for a strike. full count.
another fastball, fouled.
curveball in the dirt and benge swings over it. strike three, and the ball is blocked.
823599-60.wrap: klein fell behind 3-1, came back with two fastballs, then buried a full-count curveball that benge chased.

pitches: wrobleski starts with a fastball low, called a ball.
another fastball misses up. 2-0.
a 2-0 slider at the knees, and refsnyder takes it. 2-1.
a changeup, which the model gave 6 percent, and refsnyder takes it for strike two.
95, the hardest of the at-bat so far, up, and fouled off.
95.2, fouled again.
another changeup, out of the zone this time. full count.
full-count fastball, up out of the zone, and refsnyder puts it in play.
823923-29.wrap: wrobleski worked back from 2-0 with a slider and a changeup, but refsnyder got the 3-2 fastball and hit it out to left, a two-run homer.

pitches: lauer opens with a 77.9 mph curveball that misses up.
then 93.8 up, and raleigh swings through it. 1-1.
a cutter off the plate inside. 2-1.
a changeup away, which the model gave 14 percent, and raleigh chases. 2-2.
fastball up, fouled.
fastball misses up. full count, two on, two out.
a slider now, the fifth pitch type of the at-bat. fouled.
cutter off the plate inside and raleigh chases. strike three, inning over.
823924-5.wrap: lauer showed raleigh all five of his pitches and got two chases out of the zone. the last one, a full-count cutter, ends the first.

pitches: bases loaded, two out, one-run lead, and scott starts arenado with a slider that misses up.
fastball, fouled. 1-1.
slider below the zone, arenado chases. 1-2.
another slider, fouled.
slider, fouled again.
a fourth straight slider and arenado spoils it again.
the fastball, the model's call at 61 percent, but it misses inside. 2-2.
95 right down the middle, and arenado fouls it.
slider off the plate inside, fouled. nine pitches.
slider misses up. full count, bases loaded.
full-count slider, fouled again. eleven pitches.
slider up, and arenado swings through it. strike three. three stranded.
825051-66.wrap: twelve pitches, nine sliders, seven fouls. scott never gave in with the bases loaded, and the last slider got the swing and miss to keep the lead at one.

pitches: vesia starts moreno with 93.1 up in the zone. strike one, and the model called it.
another fastball, up, fouled. 0-2.
a third straight fastball, and this one misses up. 1-2.
a fourth straight fastball, fouled.

back to the fastball, fouled.
a changeup, his rarest pitch, at the knees. fouled again.
fastball misses. 2-2.
slider up out of the zone, fouled. nine pitches in.
fastball up out of the zone, moreno chases. strike three.
825049-53.wrap: vesia threw moreno seven fastballs and got the chase on the last one. moreno fouled off six pitches, and the game stays scoreless.

pitches: lauer goes right at marte with 93.1 up, and marte swings through it.
another fastball, on the edge, called strike two. 0-2.
fastball misses up. 1-2.
a cutter, which the model gave 10 percent, up out of the zone. 2-2.
fastball misses. full count after starting 0-2.
a cutter in the zone, fouled.
fastball, fouled again.
a cutter, called strike three, though it tracks just off the plate inside. inning over.
823916-5.wrap: lauer got ahead 0-2, slipped to full, and won it with the cutter. marte took the last one for strike three, a pitch the tracking had just off the plate inside.

pitches: down a run, bases loaded, two out in the ninth. vesia misses away with the first fastball.
92.1 down the middle and yelich swings through it. 1-1. the model called it at 69 percent.
another fastball, fouled. 1-2.
fastball misses away. 2-2.
a slider, low, fouled off.
slider misses away. full count, bases loaded.
full-count fastball, up out of the zone, and yelich puts it in play.
823915-74.wrap: vesia kept it to fastballs and sliders and got the 3-2 pitch up out of the zone. yelich grounded it to mookie betts, who threw to freddie freeman to end the inning.

pitches: tie game in the ninth, and hurt opens with a changeup that misses low.

changeup misses low. 2-2.
another changeup out of the zone, away this time. full count.
98.1 away, fouled off.
98 up, fouled again.
97.9 up out of the zone, and castro chases. strike three.
824318-75.wrap: hurt lost the changeup and fell to full, then went fastball three straight times. castro fouled off two and chased the third.

pitches: hurt starts oneil cruz with 97.8 that misses up.
another fastball misses up. 2-0.
a changeup now, but it misses low too. 3-0.
3-0, model at 84 percent fastball, and that's what it is. called strike.
a 3-1 changeup, low, and cruz swings over it. full count.
98.4 up, fouled.
98.6 at the knees, fouled again.
98.9, the hardest pitch of the at-bat, but it's down the middle and cruz puts it in play.
823911-65.wrap: hurt dug out of 3-0 but left the eighth pitch, a 98.9 fastball, over the middle. cruz hit it to center for a two-run homer that tied the game at 4.

pitches: extra innings, runners at the corners, nobody out. phillips starts with a sweeper that misses up.

sweeper up and gonzales swings through it. 1-2.

97.6 up out of the zone, and gonzales chases. strike three.
823911-79.wrap: phillips alternated sweepers and fastballs, and gonzales fouled off four in a row with two strikes. the 97.6 fastball, the hardest of the at-bat, finally got the chase.

pitches: jack dreyer opens with a 78.1 mph curveball, his least-used pitch, and riley fouls it.
94.4, fouled off. 0-2.

curveball misses up. 2-2.

same pitch, same place, same foul.
a 3-2 curveball away, which the model gave 7 percent. riley spoils it.
93.6 up, and riley swings through it. strike three.
824881-57.wrap: dreyer let a 0-2 count go full, then threw two fastballs down the middle that riley only fouled. a curveball and one more fastball up got the strikeout.

pitches: dreyer starts sean murphy with a slider and gets a swing and miss.

824881-58.wrap: dreyer had murphy 0-2 on two sliders, then missed with three of his last four. a two-out walk in a tie game.

pitches: tie game, bottom of the ninth, two on, two out. scott misses inside with a fastball.

pitches: treinen opens with a cutter away, which the model gave 3 percent. ball one.

pitches: up six, díaz starts whitcomb with 97 at the knees. strike one.
97.4 down the middle, and whitcomb swings through it. 0-2.
another fastball over the middle, fouled.
